source.excerpt: Shared as a monthly supporter ranking that also keeps a private list up to date.

body:
## What it does

Ranks five hundred people by how much they engaged that month, flags who is newly in and who dropped off, and files the result as a private X list named for the month. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @AdamLowisz shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
